entities.summary: Reverend Father Moses Orshio Adasu University formerly Benue State University is a state-owned university in Makurdi, Benue State, Nigeria. In 2006, student enrolment was over 19,000 served by 7 faculties and 23 departments. The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs with a catalogue of over 58 graduate programs across 9 colleges/faculties. It is accredited by the National Universities Commission. The current Vice-chancellor of Benue State University is Professor Tor Joe Iorapuu, who took over from Professor Msugh Moses Kembe on 3 November 2020.
